name: Brute Force
description: Adversaries may use brute force techniques to gain access to accounts by guessing passwords or otherwise attempting authentication repeatedly.
qualification: Possible technique mapping from repeated failed SSH password authentication. This does not establish malicious intent or account compromise.

name: Password Guessing
description: Adversaries may guess passwords to obtain access to victim accounts.
qualification: Possible sub-technique mapping when linked evidence explicitly records failed SSH password attempts. This is not a confirmed attack classification.
